dedupe_keys.name: datasets of faults in variable air volume terminal units in a multi zone commercial building

description: Datasets of Faults in Variable Air Volume Terminal Units in a Multi-Zone Commercial Building is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Sungkyun Jung et al. Faults in HVAC systems can decrease system efficiency and equipment lifespan, leading to 5%–30% of energy consumption being wasted in commercial buildings. We identified two common faults in HVAC variable air volume systems: a stuck damper fault in the variable air volume terminal unit and a discharge airflow sensor fault. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2025. Formats: Excel, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 33620734 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
